parameters.query:
=insert all
  when target_table = 'myob_accounts' then into raw.myob_accounts values (record_uid, payload, last_modified, batch_id, loaded_at)
  when target_table = 'myob_customers' then into raw.myob_customers values (record_uid, payload, last_modified, batch_id, loaded_at)
  when target_table = 'myob_invoices' then into raw.myob_invoices values (record_uid, payload, last_modified, batch_id, loaded_at)
  when target_table = 'myob_customer_payments' then into raw.myob_customer_payments values (record_uid, payload, last_modified, batch_id, loaded_at)
  when target_table = 'leap_matters' then into raw.leap_matters values (record_uid, payload, last_modified, batch_id, loaded_at)
  when target_table = 'leap_invoices' then into raw.leap_invoices values (record_uid, payload, last_modified, batch_id, loaded_at)
  when target_table = 'leap_trust_balances' then into raw.leap_trust_balances values (record_uid, payload, last_modified, batch_id, loaded_at)
  when target_table = 'triconvey_matters' then into raw.triconvey_matters values (record_uid, payload, last_modified, batch_id, loaded_at)
  when target_table = 'triconvey_trust_balances' then into raw.triconvey_trust_balances values (record_uid, payload, last_modified, batch_id, loaded_at)
  when target_table = 'infotrack_orders' then into raw.infotrack_orders values (record_uid, payload, last_modified, batch_id, loaded_at)
  when target_table = 'pexa_workspaces' then into raw.pexa_workspaces values (record_uid, payload, last_modified, batch_id, loaded_at)
select target_table, record_uid, parse_json(payload_text) as payload, last_modified, batch_id, loaded_at
from raw.myob_landing
where batch_id = '{{ $('Extract from Sources').first().json.batchId }}'
